import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [12, 8]
plt.rcParams['figure.autolayout'] = False

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type (boxplot)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', palette='viridis')
ax1.set_title('Camera Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price with brand differentiation (scatter plot)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().nlargest(5).index
df_top_brands = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)]
scatter = ax2.scatter(data=df_top_brands, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', 
                      c='model_year', cmap='plasma', alpha=0.7, s=50)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price (Top 5 Brands)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Model Year', fontsize=11)

# Add brand labels for some points
for brand in top_brands:
    brand_data = df_top_brands[df_top_brands['brand'] == brand]
    if len(brand_data) > 0:
        sample = brand_data.iloc[0]
        ax2.annotate(brand, (sample['megapixels'], sample['price_usd']), 
                    fontsize=9, alpha=0.8)

# 3. Body type distribution with 4K video capability (stacked bar)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
body_type_counts = df.groupby(['body_type', 'has_video_4k']).size().unstack()
body_type_counts.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, 
                      color=['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4'], edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_title('Camera Body Types with 4K Video Capability', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend(['No 4K', 'Has 4K'], title='4K Video')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Weight vs Price with sensor type (scatter with regression)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='weight_grams', y='price_usd', 
                hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', 
                s=80, alpha=0.7, palette='tab10', ax=ax4)
sns.regplot(data=df, x='weight_grams', y='price_usd', 
            scatter=False, color='gray', line_kws={'alpha': 0.5}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Price by Sensor Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(title='Sensor Type & 4K', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
